title: Research: provenance of agent commits (GitLab signed commits, push rules, protected branches, SLSA)
goal: Answer with the kb tools first and official sources for the rest, writing facts through /kb-research (new topic gitlab/commit-signing-and-provenance where no article fits): How does GitLab verify GPG, SSH and X.509 signed commits, and how does a push rule reject unsigned commits? How do protected branches and merge request approval rules limit what a bot or agent account can push or merge? What does SLSA build provenance require, and how does GitLab CI generate artifact provenance?
